source: Existing independent MusicCaps AudioSet positive targets; display names match src/task1/audioset_names.json
mapping_policy: Explicit genre/style subset of the existing target vocabulary. Mood uses only the explicitly annotated Angry music target. Genre is never converted into mood, and captions are not used to manufacture labels.
multilabel_policy: Overview: one selected annotation gets its named color; multiple selected annotations get a separate overlap color; zero selected annotations means no selected annotation, not a confirmed negative. Per-label genre panels retain every overlapping positive.
limitations: The chosen genre group includes music styles; it is an explicit analysis mapping, not a newly annotated genre taxonomy.
Only Angry music is an explicit mood target in the selected vocabulary. This view cannot establish broader mood separation.
Missing positive annotations must not be interpreted as confirmed absence of a genre or mood.
t-SNE is a descriptive projection and does not establish causal explanations or generalization.
